segments.name: travel marketplace
products: software technology products and solutions for airlines
segments.description: Runs a business-to-business travel marketplace connecting airlines, hotels and other travel suppliers with travel buyers, plus airline software solutions.
segments.evidence: We manage and report our business in one reportable segment following the disposition of our Hospitality Solutions business during 2025.

revenueModel.text: Travel suppliers and travel buyers pay Sabre transaction-based fees for bookings and for software technology solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: A significant portion of our revenue is generated through transaction-based fees that we charge to our customers.

changes.text: In 2025 Sabre sold its Hospitality Solutions business to an affiliate of TPG and now reports one segment.
changes.evidence: On July 3, 2025, we closed the transaction (the "Hospitality Solutions Sale"), resulting in cash proceeds of $965 million
